decisions.reason: Although it began as a flagship, two years without website visibility suggest the standalone offer fell below aspiration, so resources should be redirected to the broader cloud messaging platform.

The product moved from a dedicated launch page to no visible presence, which indicates weak enough results relative to aspirations that management would reallocate effort to more core workflow and messaging developments.
Despite low visibility, it still serves persistent German legacy communication needs and reuses established email and fax capabilities, so boundedly rational management would keep it a bit longer.
As a close-to-core optimization feature with likely low incremental resource needs, it can remain in the portfolio under existing organisational slack unless clearer failure appears.
Security matters strategically, but the lack of later market visibility suggests this standalone offer likely did not meet aspiration and is better absorbed into broader security services.
It complements the core platform, yet after several years without visible promotion it appears to underperform relative to aspiration, making portfolio rationalisation the more likely choice.
